text:
sam: Heads-up — seeing ~40 pods stuck Pending that target warm nodes in ap-southeast1c. Warmnode pool shows nodes in NotReady state because the GPU attach step times out during init. Anyone seen attach/detach flips like this?

claire: :eyes: saw a handful earlier, but not 40. Any logs from kubelet or nvme?

sam: grabbing logs now. kubectl describe on one of the pending pods shows: 

```
Events:
  Normal  Scheduled  2m    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned ml-train/worker-42 to warm-node-aps3-02
  Warning FailedAttachVolume  2m  attachdetach  AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "nvme0" : timed out waiting for attach/detach controller
```

and on the node: journalctl -u kubelet | tail -n 40 shows repeated: 
```
E0321 10:12:03.123 kubelet.go:234] attach/detach: failed to attach volume nvme0: timeout after 30s
E0321 10:12:03.124 kubelet_pod_manager.go:456] pod init failed: device not ready
```

jin: That timeout rings a bell — we saw conntrack/ephemeral socket exhaustion causing the nvme attach daemon to hang last month in ap-southeast. Can you check conntrack count on the warm nodes?

sam: running on a healthy warm node and a stuck warm node: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` -> healthy: 1200, stuck: 65536 (max). Oof.

leo: 65k entries means kernel conntrack table hit max and netlink ops start failing. nvme attach uses hostpath helper that does a few netlink calls -> will fail. That matches.

ops-bot: rolling alert: ap-southeast1c warmpool conntrack saturation detected (nodes: warm-node-aps3-01..05) :fire:

claire: Are we leaking conntrack entries from workloads? Any long-lived kubectl port-forwards or node-exporter bugs?

sam: quick grep of established sockets shows lots of CLOSE_WAIT from GPU driver health probes + our metrics exporter -> looks like exporter not closing sockets on transient errors.

jin: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: increase netfilter conntrack_max on warm nodes and restart kubelet/attach-daemon to clear stuck state. Longer term: fix exporter socket handling and tune warmpool lifecycle.

leo: Command to bump (one-off): `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` then `sudo systemctl restart kubelet` and `sudo systemctl restart nvme-attach.service` on those warm nodes. We should do this in a rolling manner 1 node at a time.

sam: I'm going to apply the sysctl via our bootstrap SSM run and restart services on 3 nodes to validate. Will also drain+recreate any warmnode that doesn't recover within 2m.

claire: For capacity — we should avoid scaling customer workloads into ap-southeast1c until warmpool stabilizes. Can we change scheduler routing for the next 30m?

jin: Yes — we can add a soft routing rule: prefer regions eu-west1, us-west2 for new Hosted inference batch jobs for 30m. I'll patch the routing config and push.

deploy-bot: Routing config update applied by jin at 10:23 UTC — prefer: [eu-west1, us-west2], fallback: ap-southeast1 (grace 30m).

sam: After sysctl and restarts, 2 nodes came back Ready and the pending pods started binding. One node still showing high conntrack; I nuked it and recreated from warmpool image — pods drained onto other warm nodes.

leo: Good. Postmortem action items: 1) Fix exporter to close sockets on error (jin) 2) Add conntrack usage alarm to warmpool ASG (sam) 3) Add attach/detach retry/backoff in our init hook so it fails more gracefully and retries (claire) 4) Consider increasing warmpool size by +10% in ap-southeast for peak windows (product discussion for cost).

jin: I'll open a PR for exporter fix and link tests. Sam — can you add the alarm and runbook steps?

sam: Yep. Creating an incident runbook entry now and adding nodes we touched. Runbook includes the one-liner commands and recommended rolling cadence.

claire: One more note — we should consider raising the attach/detach timeout in kubelet to avoid transient netlink lag causing immediate pod pending. But that trades off latency. Add to agenda for scheduler/ops sync.

leo: Agreed. Also capture cost impact: we briefly shifted ~80 training jobs to eu-west1 and us-west2 — estimate ~$1200 extra egress+spot costs for the hour. Tagging for finance.

ops-bot: Incident closed by sam at 10:52 UTC — warmpool healthy, routing reverted. :+1:

sam: thanks all. I'll drop the runbook link here once it's up.

jin: TY — will follow up with exporter PR and a postmortem doc later today.

sam: Runbook created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/warmpool-conntrack-runbook (internal).
